{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vylukh Clan''' was an organization that operated in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Their ships — including [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]] — were often spotted in the [[Nebulon 7]] area and near one of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] space stations.
